exposure: different doses of intrapartum intravenous fluids
cohort: 801 mother-infant pairs (176 exposed to colloids plus crystalloids and 625 exposed to crystalloids only) who underwent caesarean delivery between 2008 and 2016
finding: There was no significant difference in the risk of excess weight loss (defined as loss of >7% of birth weight) in newborns exposed to colloids plus crystalloids compared to crystalloids only during caesarean delivery.
mod_finding: The risk of excess weight loss was similar for newborns delivered via cesarean section regardless of whether their mothers received colloids plus crystalloids or crystalloids only during labor.
